pool.text: For what value of \( k \) does the system \( 3x - 6y = 12 \) and \( 2x - ky = 8 \) have infinitely many solutions?
pool.sol: For a linear system to have infinitely many solutions, the equations must be proportional. Notice that \( \dfrac{3}{2} \) is the ratio of the \( x \)-coefficients. pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, what is the area of the triangular region bounded by the lines \( y = \frac{1}{2}x \), \( y = -2x + 10 \), and the \( x \)-axis?
pool.sol: The line \( y = \frac{1}{2}x \) crosses the \( x \)-axis at \( (0,0) \). The line \( y = -2x + 10 \) crosses the \( x \)-axis at \( (5,0) \). The base along the \( x \)-axis has length \( 5 - 0 = 5 \). Finding the intersection: \( \frac{1}{2}x = -2x + 10 \Rightarrow 2.5x = 10 \Rightarrow x = 4 \), so \( y = 2 \). The height is \( 2 \). Area \( = \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 2 = 5 \).

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, the points \( (1, 3) \) and \( (7, 11) \) are the endpoints of a diameter of a circle. What is the equation of the tangent line to the circle at the point \( (7, 11) \)?

pool.text: In the \( xy \)-plane, line \( L_1 \) has the equation \( 3x - 4y = 12 \). Line \( L_2 \) is perpendicular to \( L_1 \) and passes through the point \( (6, -1) \). What is the \( y \)-intercept of line \( L_2 \)?

Using point-slope form with \( (6,-1) \): \( y - (-1) = -\frac{4}{3}(x - 6) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{4}{3}x + 8 - 1 = -\frac{4}{3}x + 7 \). The \( y \)-intercept is \( 7 \).

pool.text: Line \( k \) passes through \( (1, -1) \) and \( (3, 3) \). Line \( p \) is perpendicular to line \( k \) and passes through the point \( (8, 3) \). At what point do lines \( k \) and \( p \) intersect?
pool.sol: Slope of \( k \) is \( \frac{3 - (-1)}{3 - 1} = \frac{4}{2} = 2 \). Equation of \( k \): \( y - 3 = 2(x - 3) \Rightarrow y = 2x - 3 \). Line \( p \) has slope \( -\frac{1}{2} \) and passes through \( (8, 3) \): \( y - 3 = -\frac{1}{2}(x - 8) \Rightarrow y = -\frac{1}{2}x + 7 \). Setting them equal: \( 2x - 3 = -\frac{1}{2}x + 7 \Rightarrow \frac{5}{2}x = 10 \Rightarrow x = 4 \). Then \( y = 2(4) - 3 = 5 \). The intersection is \( (4, 5) \).

pool.text: The line \( y = kx + 7 \) intersects the line \( y = -2x + 1 \) at a point with a positive \( x \)-coordinate and a positive \( y \)-coordinate. Which condition must \( k \) satisfy?
pool.sol: Set \( kx + 7 = -2x + 1 \implies (k + 2)x = -6 \implies x = -\dfrac{6}{k + 2} \). For \( x > 0 \), we must have \( k + 2 < 0 \implies k < -2 \). Then \( y = -2\left(-\dfrac{6}{k+2}\right) + 1 = \dfrac{12}{k+2} + 1 = \dfrac{k + 14}{k + 2} \). For \( y > 0 \) when \( k + 2 < 0 \), the numerator \( k + 14 \) must also be negative: \( k + 14 < 0 \implies k < -14 \).

pool.text: What is the sum of the solutions to \( (x^2 - 3x)^2 - 2(x^2 - 3x) - 8 = 0 \)?
pool.sol: Let \( u = x^2 - 3x \): \( u^2 - 2u - 8 = 0 \implies (u - 4)(u + 2) = 0 \implies u = 4 \text{ or } u = -2 \). Case 1: \( x^2 - 3x = 4 \implies x^2 - 3x - 4 = 0 \) has discriminant \( 9 + 16 = 25 > 0 \) (2 real roots with sum 3). Case 2: \( x^2 - 3x = -2 \implies x^2 - 3x + 2 = 0 \) has discriminant \( 9 - 8 = 1 > 0 \) (2 real roots with sum 3). The sum of all 4 real solutions is \( 3 + 3 = 6 \).

pool.text: A ball is thrown upward from ground level. Its height \( h \) in meters after \( t \) seconds is \( h(t) = -5t^2 + 30t \). For how many seconds is the ball at or above a height of 40 meters?
pool.sol: Set \( -5t^2 + 30t \geq 40 \implies -5t^2 + 30t - 40 \geq 0 \). Divide by \( -5 \): \( t^2 - 6t + 8 \leq 0 \implies (t - 2)(t - 4) \leq 0 \). The ball is at or above 40 meters for \( 2 \leq t \leq 4 \), which is a duration of \( 4 - 2 = 2 \) seconds.

pool.text: If the equation \( 3x^2 - 12x + c = 0 \) has no real solutions, what is the smallest integer value of \( c \)?

pool.text: The line \( y = 2x + k \) is tangent to the parabola \( y = x^2 + 6x + 7 \). What is the value of \( k \)?
pool.sol: Set the linear and quadratic equations equal to each other: \( x^2 + 6x + 7 = 2x + k \implies x^2 + 4x + (7 - k) = 0 \). Since the line is tangent to the parabola, they intersect at exactly one point, meaning the discriminant must be zero: \( \Delta = (4)^2 - 4(1)(7 - k) = 0 \implies 16 - 28 + 4k = 0 \implies -12 + 4k = 0 \implies 4k = 12 \implies k = 3 \).

pool.text: A circle has a radius of 4 inches. A sector of the circle has a central angle of \( 72^\circ \). The area of the sector is \( k\pi \) square inches. What is the value of \( k \)?
pool.sol: Sector area \( = \frac{72}{360}\pi(4)^2 = 3.2\pi \).

pool.text: Triangle \( PQR \) is similar to triangle \( XYZ \), and the ratio of corresponding side lengths is \( 3 : 4 \). If the area of triangle \( PQR \) is 45 square units, what is the area, in square units, of triangle \( XYZ \)?
pool.sol: Areas of similar figures scale by the square of the side ratio: \( 45 \cdot \left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^2 = 80 \).
